# kosher-rust-bindings

C ABI and foreign-language bindings for kosher-rust, generated with WeaveFFI.

WebAssembly bindings for a `wasm32-unknown-unknown` build of the `kosher_rust_bindings` library, linked with `--export-table --growable-table` (for example `RUSTFLAGS="-C link-arg=--export-table -C link-arg=--growable-table"`). `init()` loads `kosher_rust_bindings.wasm` from next to this package, or from the path in `KOSHER_RUST_BINDINGS_LIBRARY` on Node.js; pass a URL, bytes, or a compiled module to load it from elsewhere:

```js

await init();
```
